title: Detect omitted registered skills and invalid boolean routing metadata
objective: Make the existing structural validator detect canonical-registry inventory omissions and reject non-boolean allow_implicit_invocation values, without editing registry authority, derived routing metadata or frozen historical baselines.

evidence.summary: Independent control reproduces false PASS for omitted seventh registered skill and string boolean.

reproduction: Run python -B scripts/agent_skills/validate_skill_architecture.py on bound main: exit0 for six derived entries despite seven registered skills. Validator line153 hardcodes6 and line140 coerces JSON string false with bool(). In temporary fixture, omit a canonical registered skill or replace true with string false; both must be rejected.

positive: Complete derived inventory matching canonical registered skill rows validates under temporary fixtures.
Real JSON booleans preserve current side-effect validation.
negative: Omitted canonical registered skill fails regardless of total hardcoded count.
String false, string true, integers and null are rejected as booleans.
Frozen BASELINES.json and current registry/index/skill bodies remain unchanged.
A new or retired registered skill cannot silently escape set reconciliation.

clean_noop_condition: Stop if superseded or current validator already rejects both reproduced controls.
escalation_condition: Stop if fixing validator requires editing canonical registry, routing authority, skill bodies, workflow or policy semantics.
